package.name: obstacle_context_msgs
package.description:
Custom messages for obstacle cluster tracking.
Vendored copy. The definitions are owned by the obstacle detector (dynamic_obstacle_detector); this copy exists so co_driver builds and runs on a vehicle that does not carry the detector's workspace. Without it, CMake drops obstacle_avoid, the config still names that scorer type, and the node used to refuse to start - no /drive, no status, nothing driving the car.
Keep byte-identical to the detector's definitions. The two must generate the same type hash or publisher and subscriber silently stop matching, and nothing reports an error - the topic simply carries no data. If the detector changes a field, copy the .msg files across in the same change.
